ENVIRONMENT_ID.description: Immutable Environment ID assigned to this Spoke

AGENT_ID.description: Unique Agent ID within the Environment

BOOTSTRAP_ADMINISTRATORS.description: Comma-separated authenticated subjects allowed to establish initial governance

HELM_PLAIN_HTTP.description: Permit plain HTTP only for an explicitly isolated local OCI registry

HUB_TLS_SECRET.description: Existing Secret containing ca.crt, tls.crt, and tls.key for the Hub

AGENT_TLS_SECRET.description: Existing Secret containing ca.crt, tls.crt, and tls.key for the Spoke Agent

PACKAGING_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS.description: Plaintext host:port of the operator-supplied Temporal frontend used by the Hub packaging client and optional packaging worker. Leave empty to disable the Hub client; explicitly set with REPOSITORY_KIND=postgres before selecting packaging-worker. No URL or credentials; TLS and API-key configuration are not exposed by this package.

PACKAGING_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.description: Temporal namespace shared by the Hub packaging client and optional packaging worker. Read only when PACKAGING_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS is set; not a Kubernetes namespace.

PACKAGING_TEMPORAL_TASK_QUEUE.description: Temporal task queue shared by the Hub packaging client and optional packaging worker. Read only when PACKAGING_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS is set.

PACKAGING_POSTGRES_SECRET.description: Existing Secret whose dsn key is the Hub Postgres DSN. Read by the Hub when REPOSITORY_KIND=postgres and by the optional packaging-worker component.

REPOSITORY_KIND.description: Selects the Hub profile. postgres is the production profile (rolling update, PodDisruptionBudget, DSN from PACKAGING_POSTGRES_SECRET, and two replicas once PLANNING_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS is set) and is required for metrics and the packaging worker. file is a single-replica development and evaluation profile on the package PVC.

METRICS_ADDRESS.description: Hub metrics listener. Leave empty for none. Set to :9090 only together with REPOSITORY_KIND=postgres; the file repository serves no metrics.

RATE_LIMIT_OPERATOR_RPS.description: Sustained requests per second the Hub allows one operator. Leave empty for the Hub default (100). The Hub refuses to start on zero or on more than 1000000.

RATE_LIMIT_OPERATOR_BURST.description: Requests the Hub allows one operator at once. Leave empty for the Hub default (600). The Hub refuses to start on more than 1000000.

RATE_LIMIT_AGENT_RPS.description: Sustained requests per second the Hub allows one Agent. Leave empty for the Hub default (20). The Hub refuses to start on zero or on more than 1000000.

RATE_LIMIT_AGENT_BURST.description: Requests the Hub allows one Agent at once. Leave empty for the Hub default (60). The Hub refuses to start on more than 1000000.

RATE_LIMIT_ANONYMOUS_RPS.description: Sustained requests per second the Hub allows one remote address. Leave empty for the Hub default (10). The Hub refuses to start on zero or on more than 1000000.

RATE_LIMIT_ANONYMOUS_BURST.description: Requests the Hub allows one remote address at once. Leave empty for the Hub default (60). The Hub refuses to start on more than 1000000.

NOTIFICATION_TRANSPORT.description: Notification delivery transport. Any enabled transport requires REPOSITORY_KIND=postgres. Credentials are existing object references only.

NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET_NAME.description: Existing Secret containing the full webhook URL. Required only for webhook transport.

NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET_KEY.description: Key of the webhook URL in NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET_NAME.

NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT.description: Bound on one webhook attempt. Empty keeps the Hub default.

NOTIFICATION_NATIVE_TIMEOUT.description: Bound on one SMTP or Slack attempt. Must remain below the delivery lease of 30 seconds.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_ADDRESS.description: SMTP host:port. Enables the native email channel; requires NOTIFICATION_SMTP_FROM.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_FROM.description: Sender mailbox for native email. Unicode display names are preserved; controls and Unicode line separators are refused.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_TLS_MODE.description: Empty or starttls uses STARTTLS; tls uses implicit TLS. Plaintext is unsupported.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_CREDENTIALS_SECRET_NAM.description: Existing Secret containing SMTP username and password. Empty uses no SMTP authentication.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_USERNAME_KEY.description: SMTP username key in the credentials Secret.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_PASSWORD_KEY.description: SMTP password key in the credentials Secret.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_CA_CONFIGMAP_NAME.description: Existing ConfigMap containing a private SMTP CA. Empty uses system trust roots.

NOTIFICATION_SMTP_CA_KEY.description: CA bundle key in the SMTP ConfigMap.

NOTIFICATION_SLACK_TOKEN_SECRET_NAME.description: Existing Secret containing the Slack token. Enables the native Slack channel.

NOTIFICATION_SLACK_TOKEN_KEY.description: Slack token key in the Secret.

PLAN_ORCHESTRATOR.description: Plan lifecycle driver. temporal requires PLAN_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS; the frontend is operator-supplied, plaintext, and uses Temporal namespace default.

PLAN_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS.description: Explicit host:port of the Plan lifecycle Temporal frontend. Independent of planning sessions and packaging worker settings.

MATERIAL_PREPARER_COMMAND.description: Absolute executable path of the external Spoke material preparer. Empty leaves preparation disabled; an existing PVC can supply additional tools.

MATERIAL_PREPARER_TOOLS_PVC.description: Existing PVC containing the operator-supplied preparer. Mounted read-only only when its command is configured.

MATERIAL_PREPARER_TOOLS_MOUNT_PATH.description: Read-only mount path for the preparer tools PVC.

CONSOLE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Browser origin of the Hub console. The Hub builds its sign-in redirect address from it and accepts a session cookie only from it, so it must be the address people actually use. Inert while OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER is empty. The optional uds component registers the same address with Keycloak.

OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER.description: OIDC issuer for operator sign-in. Leave empty on a plain Zarf install that has no Keycloak.

OPERATOR_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: OIDC client ID for operator sign-in. Leave empty when OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER is empty.

OPERATOR_OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM.description: Token claim that carries the operator username. Leave empty when OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER is empty.

OPERATOR_OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM.description: Token claim that carries operator groups. Leave empty when OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER is empty.

OPERATOR_OIDC_CA_FILE.description: CA bundle used to verify the issuer. Leave empty when OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER is empty.

OPERATOR_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Existing Secret whose client-secret key is the OIDC client secret for browser sign-in. The optional uds component has UDS Core create it. Read only when OPERATOR_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE is set.

OPERATOR_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE.description: Set to /run/conduit-sso/client-secret to sign in as the confidential client in OPERATOR_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET. Leave empty for a public client, which relies on PKCE alone, or when OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER is empty.

OPERATOR_SESSION_MAX_LIFETIME.description: Longest a browser session may last, as a Go duration between 5m and 24h. A session also ends when its ID token expires. Leave empty for the default of 8h, and when OPERATOR_OIDC_ISSUER is empty.

POSTGRES_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace of the operator-supplied Postgres. Used only by the optional uds component.

POSTGRES_NAME_LABEL.description: app.kubernetes.io/name value on the operator-supplied Postgres pods. Used only by the optional uds component.

OIDC_ISSUER_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace of the in-cluster OIDC issuer (Keycloak) Pods. Used only by the optional uds component.

OIDC_ISSUER_NAME_LABEL.description: app.kubernetes.io/name value on the in-cluster OIDC issuer Pods. Used only by the optional uds component.

CHART_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace of the in-cluster OCI registry the Spoke pulls charts from. Used only by the optional uds component.

CHART_REGISTRY_LABEL_KEY.description: Pod label key that selects the chart registry. Used only by the optional uds component.

CHART_REGISTRY_LABEL_VALUE.description: Pod label value that selects the chart registry. Used only by the optional uds component.

TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.description: Kubernetes namespace of the operator-supplied Temporal frontend. Used only by the optional uds component.

TEMPORAL_NAME_LABEL.description: app.kubernetes.io/name value on the operator-supplied Temporal frontend Pods. Used only by the optional uds component.

PLANNING_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS.description: host:port of the operator-supplied Temporal frontend that holds planning sessions. Required for two Hub replicas - with REPOSITORY_KIND=postgres and this set the Hub runs two replicas that share planning state; left empty the Hub runs one replica with a process-local planning store.

PLANNING_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.description: Temporal namespace for planning sessions. Read only when PLANNING_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS is set.

PLANNING_TEMPORAL_TASK_QUEUE.description: Temporal task queue for planning sessions. Read only when PLANNING_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS is set.

MODEL_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint, for example https://models.example/v1. Leave empty for no model call. No credentials, query, or fragment.

MODEL_NAME.description: Model id sent in each request and recorded as the configured model. Required when MODEL_BASE_URL is set; the Hub refuses to start without it.

ASSISTANT_MODEL_NAME.description: assistant model id on MODEL_BASE_URL. Empty inherits MODEL_NAME.

ASSISTANT_MODEL_TIMEOUT.description: assistant model request deadline. Empty inherits MODEL_TIMEOUT.

PLANNING_MODEL_NAME.description: planning model id on MODEL_BASE_URL. Empty inherits MODEL_NAME.

PLANNING_MODEL_TIMEOUT.description: planning model request deadline. Empty inherits MODEL_TIMEOUT.

PACKAGING_MODEL_NAME.description: packaging model id on MODEL_BASE_URL. Empty inherits MODEL_NAME.

PACKAGING_MODEL_TIMEOUT.description: packaging model request deadline. Empty inherits MODEL_TIMEOUT.

APPGEN_MODEL_NAME.description: appgen model id on MODEL_BASE_URL. Empty inherits MODEL_NAME.

APPGEN_MODEL_TIMEOUT.description: appgen model request deadline. Empty inherits MODEL_TIMEOUT.

MODEL_TIMEOUT.description: Bound on one whole model request, for example 90s. Leave empty for the Hub default of 45s.

MODEL_API_KEY_SECRET.description: Existing Secret whose api-key key is the model API key. Mounted only as a file. Read only when MODEL_API_KEY_FILE is set.

MODEL_API_KEY_FILE.description: Set to /run/conduit-model/api-key to send the key from MODEL_API_KEY_SECRET. Leave empty for a keyless endpoint.

MODEL_CA_CONFIGMAP.description: Existing ConfigMap whose ca.pem key is a private CA for the model endpoint. Read only when MODEL_CA_FILE is set.

MODEL_CA_FILE.description: Set to /run/conduit-model-ca/ca.pem to trust MODEL_CA_CONFIGMAP in addition to the system roots. Leave empty otherwise.

MODEL_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.description: Permit a plain http MODEL_BASE_URL. The key and every prompt then cross the cluster network unencrypted unless a service mesh encrypts that hop.

MODEL_SERVICE_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace of an in-cluster model service the Hub may reach. The default names no namespace, so no egress is granted until it is set. Used only by the optional uds components.

MODEL_SERVICE_NAME_LABEL.description: app.kubernetes.io/name value on the in-cluster model service Pods. Used only by the optional uds components.

UDS_METRICS.description: Enable the Hub monitor in the single optional UDS Package owner. Requires a postgres Hub listening on :9090.
